mike-support: NorthStarAI reported an embedding mismatch from last night's ingest. Search returning duplicates and wrong similarity ranks. They called out renewal in 12 days. Logs: s3://redwood/northstar/ingest/2026-04-12/abc

sarah-cs: assigning @jasmine-cs to lead handoff. need short impact summary + remediation ETA so we can message customer.

jasmine-cs: taking point. @mike-support can you quantify customer-visible impact? rollback possible?

mike-support: approx 25% of queries impacted; affected queries see ~+0.6s latency and incorrect top-k. Repro: run embed job with model v1.2.3 and diff ids. Suspect race in chunked upload. Log sample: `ERROR vector_id mismatch batch=17 worker=ingest-3`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0412-17 — sev:high — owner: eng-runtime

vince-cs: suggested comms: 1) immediate acknowledgment, 2) break-fix (ingest retry) ETA 3-4h, 3) follow-up call + exec note, 4) postmortem + credits if SLA hit. I'll draft the customer note.

jasmine-cs: eng timeline: triage now, hotfix branch open, QA 1.5-2h, deploy+verify 1h. If green, we'll call at 15:00 PT. @ana-sales can you book?

ana-sales: invite sent for 15:00 PT. looped in renewal owner @maria-rev.

mike-support: ran `tools/retry_ingest.py --customer northstarai --batch 17`. Reprocess done; verification shows ~95% alignment. Logs: s3://redwood/northstar/ingest/2026-04-12/verify.log

jasmine-cs: called customer early to share status. they want 1-week renewal extension and credits. agreed to follow-up postmortem and longer log retention. next owners: jasmine-cs (CS), eng-runtime (fix & QA), docs (upload guidance).

maria-rev: approved 1-week extension. escalate if any regression.

jasmine-cs: closing loop here. will post postmortem link when ready. thanks all. :v:
